description: Canonical inventory of the top-level media/ directory (sibling of jCRPG-engine/) — the real, plain-text/plain-image source asset tree the engine's code expects at '../media/' relative to jCRPG-engine. This supersedes the 'not present' assumptions in earlier passes of rendering_assets.json/worlds.json/world_seed0_sample.json; those files have been corrected to reference this one.
javaExpectedPath: ../media/ (relative to jCRPG-engine working directory, per org.jcrpg.apps.BinaryConverter, org.jcrpg.ui.UIBase resource locators, org.jcrpg.threed.engine.TrimeshGeometryBatch.shaderDirectory)

models.note: grass/ has no .obj, only a raw 3ds source (grass_plane1.3ds) — grass is otherwise handled via billboard shaders, not per-instance meshes.

sides.note: Source for org.jcrpg.space.sidetype Cube-face geometry (maze walls/ground, cactus, doors, roofs, generic hill/ground pieces).

texturesModels.note: Per-quality-tier texture sets matching the config.properties TEXTURE_QUALITY tiers; 'common' likely holds shared/utility textures used across all tiers.

texturesOther.flare: media/textures/flare/ (lens flare sprites, paired with flaresmall.jpg at media root)

icons.javaOwner: UIImageCache.getImage(...getIconFilePath()) calls across ui/window/interaction/* (inventory/item icons, status effect icons, entity/creature icons)

sky.note: 6-sided skybox with separate day/ and night/ variants for top+sky faces (side faces presumably shared/static).

shaders.crossReference: jCRPG-engine/json/rendering_assets.json (full shader catalogue including in-repo compiled shaders and third-party jar-bundled shaders)

verifiedAgainstStarterParty.usedBy: also present under portraits/elf/female/ — ELMARA (starter_party.json) uses the elf/female copy

portraits.note: Each portrait has a matching .license file (per-image attribution/license, e.g. francesco_hayez1.license).

fonts.note: Source art backing the compiled jCRPG-engine/src/main/resources/org/jcrpg/ui/vinque.fnt + vinque_0.png used in-game.

scenarioData.significance: These are the actual scenario data files org.jcrpg.game.scenario.Scenario.load() reads (previously assumed missing from this repo). See jCRPG-engine/json/worlds.json realDefaultWorldParams/realDefaultEcology for parsed content, cross-checked against the real generated world in world_seed0_sample.json.

configs.note: Quality presets equivalent in shape to jCRPG-engine/config.properties (see game_assets.json renderSettings).

misc.note: flaresmall.jpg/floppy.jpg are loose top-level images (lens flare thumbnail, save-icon 'floppy disk' art); .project is an Eclipse project file for the media resource tree itself.

webPort.approach: Use media/ as the single source of truth for all visual/audio asset conversion: .obj/.mtl -> three.js OBJLoader/MTLLoader or pre-baked glTF; .dds -> .png/.webp; sky/ -> a CubeTextureLoader skybox (day/night variants swapped by time-of-day); portraits/icons/ui -> served as-is (already .png/.jpg); audio/ -> served as-is or transcoded to a web-friendly codec.
